tips_en: Start with Paper 3 (JITMEM) — its read-time memory curation paradigm challenges conventional write-time approaches and delivers strong gains (+16 points on ALFWorld and WebShop), making it the most broadly impactful read. Papers 2 and 3 are tightly complementary (both tackle LLM agent memory but from opposite angles: structured multi-party dialogue memory vs. task-adaptive trajectory memory), so reading them back-to-back offers a rich comparative view of the memory design space. Paper 1 (PWM-WROP) stands apart as a cognitive-science-flavored video world model paper — interesting on its own but lower priority unless world models or object permanence are your focus.
tips_zh: 建议先读第3篇（JITMEM）——它在读取时进行记忆整理的范式颠覆了传统的写入时方法，且在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上取得了显著提升（+16分），是三篇中影响力最广的。第2篇和第3篇高度互补（都研究 LLM Agent 记忆，但角度相反：一个是面向多人对话的结构化记忆，另一个是面向任务自适应的轨迹记忆），连续阅读可获得对记忆设计空间的全面对比。第1篇（PWM-WROP）是结合认知科学的视频世界模型工作，独立价值突出，但除非你专注于世界模型或物体永久性，否则优先级较低。
